items.title: SK Hynix Breaks Ground on Critical Nvidia Supply Play
items.author: Moz Farooque ACCA      Thu, August 27, 2026 at 12:36 PM PDT   2 min read
items.highlights: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) is putting another major piece of the AI supply chain on U.S. soil, breaking ground Thursday on an approximately $4 billion high-bandwidth memory packaging and research complex in West Lafayette, Indiana. The project matters to investors because HBM has emerged as one of the most critical components inside Nvidia-powered AI systems, and SK Hynix is betting demand will remain strong enough to justify substantially more capacity through the end of the decade.
